premises.text: Peer-to-peer payment services have a large user base and significant cash balances
premises.evidence_span: Eight out of 10 of us have sent cash to a friend using a peer-to-peer payment service. That's over 150 million users transacting 1.2 trillion just this year alone. And two-thirds of those users have cash balances in their app.

premises.text: Idle cash in peer-to-peer apps loses value due to inflation
premises.evidence_span: if you left idle cash, in there, you just took a cut.

premises.text: Users want to earn and grow their wealth through simple means
premises.evidence_span: Millennials, Gen Z, all of us want to earn and grow our wealth, but sometimes just lack the resources, time or energy or resources to invest.

premises.text: Peer-to-peer payments can be transformed into investment opportunities
premises.evidence_span: What if peer-to-peer paybacks wasn't just a way to settle tabs, but was a way to actually build generational wealth?

premises.text: Stax allows users to send stock as payment, contributing to wealth growth
premises.evidence_span: I just contributed to her long-term wealth goals just by going out to dinner with her.

premises.text: Stax simplifies the process of sending stock compared to traditional methods
premises.evidence_span: Before, sending stock was extremely difficult. The sender paid taxes, filled out paperwork, there were high fees, and tons of delays.

premises.text: Stax provides a secure way to manage user cash balances and investments
premises.evidence_span: we cover up to $250,000 of user cash balances and $500,000 of portfolio investments using our brokerage partner, Alpaca.

premises.text: Stax democratizes investing by making it accessible through everyday transactions
premises.evidence_span: we're bringing a whole new group of individuals into the market and creating new ways that they can access it.

value.text: Users can grow their wealth through everyday peer-to-peer transactions
value.evidence_span: join us as we create limitless value with every single transaction.

notes: No separate premises for user experience details as they support the main claims.
